messages:
Maya Patel: Kicking off prep for LLMConf NYC booth + speaking + swag. High-level: booth layout, speaking submissions, swag count + shipping, and on-site staffing. Can folks confirm owners? :wave:

Ethan Cole: I can own booth logistics (shipping, vendor point-of-contact). Need final booth footprint and weight limits by EOD Thurs.

Jules Romero: I’ll own creative  banners, table runners, and swag art. Do we have the exact booth dimensions? Also need logo vector and font files.

Ben Ortiz: Booth dimensions from organizer: 10x20ft (inline) with 8ft backwall. Max crate weight 150lbs. Shipping deadline to warehouse: 2025-06-10. PO should reference PO#RI-2249.

Maya Patel: @Ben thanks. Add margin for crates  plan two crates 100lbs each. Ethan, can you book freight with vendor we used for KubeCon? Quick link: https://drive.google.com/ri-ship-guide

Ethan Cole: Yep I’ll reach out to Meridian Freight. Quick note: Meridian needs artwork to print a 96" backdrop by 2025-05-28 to meet print queue. Jules pls confirm.

Jules Romero: Will do. Uploading dielines & proofs to Drive tonight. Main ask: backdrop with product snapshot + 3-line value prop. Also two pull-up banners and 1 table runner.

Vivian Chen: On speaking submissions: we have one slot in the track app  deadline 2025-05-15. Suggest submitting two talk ideas: (1) "Serving LLMs at scale with predictable economics" (PR/benchmarks angle), (2) "Observability for inference: debugging token-level regressions" (product/console demo). Who wants to co-present?

Maya Patel: I can present the benchmarks narrative with Research. @Jules can you prep 2 slides for the first talk showing latency vs cost? Keep it simple.

Jules Romero: Yep, 2 slides mock by Tue. Need sample graphs or numbers. @Maya pls drop a short data snippet I can mock.

Maya Patel: Dropping sample in the drive: numbers are median p95 latency 65ms public model, 28ms on Redwood ded. cost per 1k tokens reduced 35%. Use these as placeholders.

Ben Ortiz: Swag counts  propose: 1,000 stickers, 400 tees (mix S-XL), 200 enamel pins, 50 plush stress-toy tokens. Budget cap $9k. Approve?

Ethan Cole: I recommend 750 stickers + 300 tees + 150 pins to hit budget and shipping weight. We over-ordered last year. :+1:

Vivian Chen: We should reserve 3 staffers per shift. Conference hours 9am-6pm. Staff shifts: 8:301pm, 16:30pm. Volunteers? @Maya @Ethan @Jules?

Maya Patel: I’ll cover morning slot Day 1 and afternoon Day 2.

Jules Romero: I can do afternoon Day 1 and morning Day 2.

Ethan Cole: I’ll take the remaining slots. Also requesting a small A/V package: laptop HDMI, single mic, and a power strip at the booth for live demo. Add to vendor request.

EventsBot: Reminder  booth payment deadline in 7 days. Invoice ID: INV-LLM-0923.

Ben Ortiz: Noted. Ethan, please attach invoice to the Meridian booking so finance can pay.

Vivian Chen: For lead routing: set up two intake forms  one for prospects (product demo request) and one for partners. Route prospects to sales@redwood.ai and partners to partnerships@redwood.ai. Can Marketing Ops make Zap to HubSpot?

Maya Patel: Marketing Ops (cc @Ethan)  create forms, map UTMs, and tag leads with source=llmconf_nyc. We’ll use qr codes on table cards linking to the demo form.

Jules Romero: Swag artwork question: do we want conference-only art (LLMConf 2025) or evergreen Redwood? Conference-only sells better. Leaning conference-only.

Maya Patel: Conference-specific for pins and tees; stickers evergreen. Order deadlines: stickers & pins by 2025-05-20, tees by 2025-05-12.

Ethan Cole: I'll confirm shipping address: LLMConf Warehouse, 405 Export Ave, Jersey City, NJ 07302. Contact at dock: Mike 555-0198.

Ben Ortiz: Also confirm electricity/amperage on site  organizer says 110V/15A per booth unless ordered otherwise. If we want A/V + chargers, we should order 20A.

Maya Patel: Action items recap: Ethan  book freight + vendor invoicing + order A/V; Jules  final creative proofs + swag mockups; Ben  finalize swag counts & ship dates; Vivian  submit talks and set up lead routing; Maya  submit benchmark talk and coordinate slides. All updates in this thread pls.

Ethan Cole: Will update by tomorrow EOD with freight quote.

Jules Romero: Proofs uploaded. Ping me if anything off.

Vivian Chen: I'll submit talk 1 today and talk 2 as backup.

Maya Patel: Awesome team. One more thing  let's bring a small bowl of promo cards with a QR code for the demo, and a signup sheet for on-site meetings. Low friction. :sparkles:

Ethan Cole: Agreed. I'll order 500 gloss cards.

Ben Ortiz: Logging PO draft now (PO#RI-2249). Will share with finance.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone  closing loop after freight quote. :raised_hands:
